$comment: Invariant ids that MUST have an owning test right now. `pnpm test:coverage-map` fails when an id listed here has no test whose name contains it. The registry itself lives in docs/invariants.md and carries 424 ids; this file says which of them are load-bearing today.
phaseNote: P0 owns the six ids below (plan §Phases, P0 gate: DAY-01/05 + CER-01 at 10,000 cases in four zones, the PER-06 DB-path gate, and the PLAT-01/02 build gates). P1 extends this list with every id in §1-§10 (SESS, GRD, SCH, ECO, PATH, DAY, FRZ/REC, CER), §13 (PER/DAT) and §14 (PACK/AUD) engine parts, plus SEC-01/02 — see the plan's P1 gate row. Adding an id here without its test turns CI red, which is the point: an invariant with no owning test is worse than a failing one.
